benefit: Buckwheat strips between cucurbit rows host hoverflies, parasitic wasps, and minute pirate bugs that suppress squash bug eggs and cucumber beetle larvae. Buckwheat blooms in 30 days for sustained nectar.

members.title: Buckwheat alley between cucurbit rows
members.body: Drill buckwheat at 60 lb per acre in 30 inch alleys between cucurbit rows at vining. Mow before seed-set to prevent volunteers.
